hypothesis_source: Native measurement held108blocks after LOAD ACK while full-history requires98more, delayed successful allocation656.683ms. Native inflight prefill bookkeeping exists but ordinary running/waiting allocations do not all honor reserved_blocks. Physical tail holdings may protect recovery until recompute, at cost to other requests.
stop_rule: Retain all four arms and all planned requests, failures and unfinished. Verify actual extra held blocks, recovery-demand-to-next-output, and whole-population outcomes including output and copy work. If no action or no stable benefit, trace next dependency rather than adding pressure or predictors. Natural EOS work differences disallow pure scheduling speedup attribution.

intervention.full_tail: Only preempted async LOAD with original num_new_tokens0/external>0/delay/fullfit: pass remaining current history as allocator-only num_new_tokens. intervention.limitation: Native reserved_blocks check now applies to full history allocation. Candidate can fail LOAD admission that native prefix allocation would pass when other reservations exist; record this as a policy cost. No future output capacity reserved.

correctness_scope: Single plain FullAttention no prefix sharing/spec/encoder; normal recovery through natural EOS. Original completed/abort STORE uses request token count, so arbitrary mid-recovery cancellation is not independently proved here. No active cancel injected. Errors/timeouts remain in denominator and fail the run; no output-quality claim without later task validation.
